datasets.title: Fiji: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Fiji: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/fiji-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

lineage.description: High-resolution population density maps were generated by applying machine learning algorithms to commercially available satellite imagery to identify building footprints, then overlaying population estimates derived from census data and demographic statistics in partnership with Columbia University. The resulting gridded datasets represent population distribution at fine spatial resolution for Fiji's overall population and seven demographic subgroups.

sources.name: Facebook AI and Data for Good
sources.description: Machine learning model applied to satellite imagery to identify building footprints and infer population distribution at high spatial resolution

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology based on publicly available census data and demographic statistics overlaid with building-level spatial data
